# v0.1.15

Stable release of the provider reliability and packaging hardening work validated through source, live-provider, and packed-install release gates.

## What Changed

- Context7 automatic documentation selection now requires query-subject overlap with candidate title or id, with Exa handling an empty or low-confidence Context7 result in the same capability.
- AnySearch supports repeatable `--param key=value` overrides, validates malformed structured parameters before network calls, and keeps extract length limits local.
- Provider failures now map to consistent contract error types; Tavily can be disabled without accidental routing or network requests; mock and live smoke reports distinguish healthy, degraded, failed, and skipped checks.
- Release safety now includes a read-only PR CI matrix, public/package skill parity checking, and a clean temporary-prefix tarball install smoke before publication.
- The publish workflow serializes npm releases and recognizes stable version changes against the first parent, so merge and squash release commits do not race into an automatic beta publish.

## Upgrade

```powershell
npm install -g @konbakuyomu/smart-search@latest
smart-search --version
smart-search skills update --targets codex --format json
```

Expected version after publish: `smart-search 0.1.15` from npm `latest`.

## Validation

- Source checkout: `python -m pytest tests -q`, `python -m smart_search.cli regression`, and `python -m smart_search.cli smoke --mock --format json`
- Packaging: `npm test`, `npm run pack:dry`, `npm run check:skill-parity`, and `npm run smoke:tarball`
- Installed package: `smart-search --version`, packaged `smart-search regression`, and `smart-search smoke --mock --format json`
